payload.title: Implement query filters pushed down to SQLite
payload.description:
**Files:** `src/store/query.rs`, `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `02_filters.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** composable filter methods on `Query` (source/agent, project, part kind via EXISTS over parts, activity since/until, limit) compiled into the WHERE clauses of the existing prepared statements — the engine filters; callers never materialize everything to compare properties. The filter surface deliberately mirrors the existing `botspy sessions` flags (--source/--project/--since/--until/--limit) so a future CLI verb over the store is a thin shell — but no CLI changes in this initiative.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
